definitions.explanation: A piece of furniture for sitting, typically with a back and four legs. Can refer to any type of chair.

examples.japanese: {椅子|いす}に{座|すわ}ってください。
この{椅子|いす}は{高|たか}いですね。
examples.english: This chair is tall, isn't it?

examples.japanese: {椅子|いす}から{立|た}って、{窓|まど}を{開|あ}けてください。
examples.english: Please stand up from the chair and open the window.

examples.japanese: {教室|きょうしつ}には{机|つくえ}と{椅子|いす}がたくさんありますが、{学生|がくせい}は{少|すく}ないです。
examples.english: There are many desks and chairs in the classroom, but there are few students.

notes: Usually written in hiragana (いす) or mixed ({椅子|いす}). Counter: {脚|きゃく}. Uses {座|すわ}る (to sit) and {立|た}つ (to stand). Types include: ソファー (sofa), ベンチ (bench).
